name: The Tynemouth Castle Inn
accommodation: 72 en-suite bedrooms including sea-view, family and terrace rooms, plus accessible rooms
parking: Free guest parking behind the inn, limited and first come first served; 24 hours per night of stay
dogs: Up to two dogs when booking direct (charge applies); dog-friendly garden and terrace rooms; dogs welcome in designated pub areas
confirmedFeatures: Bar and restaurant, free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV, tea and coffee making, in-room safe, accessible rooms
overview: A large inn on Grand Parade overlooking Longsands, around 200 metres from the sand. Its 72 en-suite rooms range from sea-view doubles to family rooms and terrace rooms with their own outdoor space, and there is a pub and restaurant downstairs. Guest parking is available behind the building, though spaces are limited.
surfTripFit: A two-minute walk to Longsands, on-site food and drink and dog-friendly terrace rooms make it an easy base for a surf weekend.
